evidence_cutoff: Saved EPL source snapshot of October20,2026; compilation of final report performs no new fitting, forecasting or settlement.

provided_epl_material.consequence: No newly edited EPL results in ML Sports PDF. Use frozen source tables and latest concise wording, while restoring proposal-aligned first-stage accuracy/calibration comparison.

recommended_main_narrative: Anchor the proposal question in the locked first experiment: accuracy-selected versus calibration-selected families.
Explain both validation-selected primary strategies hold cash; do not replace that decision with the positive secondary or exploratory best returns.
Then separate four-year feature studies and116strategy laboratory as exploratory extensions, not additional untouched tests.
Show same-population market/team/player/frequency prediction scores, capital rules and whole-portfolio equity graph.
Conclude richer tested player features fail to beat matched team controls and historical profits remain unvalidated.

first_experiment.question: Does selecting by calibration differ from selecting by accuracy for EPL probabilities and hypothetical betting returns?
first_experiment.test_status: Initially held-out 2025/26 in first study. Subsequent analyses have inspected it and are retrospective exploratory redesigns.

best_learned.title: Best learned predictor by pooled log loss
best_learned.description: Starts with normalized inverse Bet365 odds and learns regularized H/D log-odds adjustments relative to away. Uses 28 historical inputs: 9 team performance, 4 context flags, 8 source-coverage controls and 7 rolling FPL aggregates. Separately temperature-calibrated. Uses odds as an input; is not an odds-free model.

strongest_benchmark.title: Strongest observed benchmark
strongest_benchmark.description: Normalized inverse archived Bet365 H/D/A odds. No learned feature coefficients. Lowest pooled log loss and Brier among all19 compared series.

simplest.title: Simplest implemented predictive model
simplest.description: Predicts the same H/D/A fitting-block frequencies for every match in an evaluation season. Recomputed only when moving to a new chronological outer fold. No match features, team identity or odds input. Constant forecasts can have low ECE despite weak resolution.
simplest.formula: p_k = count(fitting outcomes == k) / fitting match count

team.title: Team-data logistic regression
team.description: Multinomial L2 logistic model with 21 declared inputs: 9 lagged team-performance measures,4 promotion/prior-season-context flags and8 shared source-coverage controls. Performance inputs include season-to-date/last10 goals and shots-on-target differences, corners, recent points, prior-season win rates and rest. Median imputation, missingness indicators and scaling fit only within training. No player-performance or odds inputs.

player.title: Player-form logistic regression
player.description: 96 declared inputs:90 player-performance aggregates plus6 shared coverage fields. Last5/10 same-season fixture slots summarize12 FPL measures plus active-player,60minute-player and minute counts, represented for home,away and home-minus-away. No team-strength inputs, position labels or odds inputs. Best pooled log loss among4 pure-player variants; still worse than matched team control.

player_squad.title: Player squad model: form + projected XI + depth
player_squad.description: 222 declared inputs with form,position profiles,prior-minute projected1GK/4DEF/4MID/2FWD XI and depth/continuity. Projected XI is a past-minute proxy and can be incomplete; not announced lineups. Fixed archived role fallback publication clocks are unverified.
